purpose: Every local OMO fix we own, in dependency order. Applied automatically by local-fixes/apply.mjs after an OMO update so a rebuilt dist always contains all of them.

fixes.title: Post-compaction auto-continue no longer inherits the compaction model
fixes.why: OpenCode's synthetic post-compaction continue inherited the summarize request's model, so an agent whose compaction.model differs from the running model made the compaction model continue the task.
fixes.orderNote: Adds plugin/compaction-autocontinue-reroute.ts. 02 refines the same file, so 02 must come after 01.

fixes.title: Resolve the continue's working model from the last real assistant turn
fixes.why: The first fix resolved 'working model' from the newest message carrying agent+model fields, which matched compaction summaries and the internal compaction_continue prompts themselves — a self-sustaining loop that silently switched live sessions to the summarizer model.
fixes.orderNote: Modifies the file added by 01. Keep after 01.

fixes.title: Keep the admission guard after a timed-out summarize; reject empty summaries
fixes.why: An abandoned summarize never latched the session, so the next tool call after the cooldown recomputed the ratio from the stale pre-compaction measurement and started another compaction; one fired at a real fill of 7 percent.
fixes.orderNote: Touches preemptive-compaction-trigger.ts, which 04 also rewrites. Keep 03 before 04.

fixes.title: Make the summarizer pin resolve, log why, and never deadlock
fixes.why: agents.<key>.compaction.model silently fell back to the session model on every failure path with no logging, and the failure log printed the SESSION model — a dead pin looked exactly like a working one. Four production compactions ran on the session model while the config pinned GLM.
fixes.orderNote: This is the local-lineage form, which builds on 03's empty-summary module. PR #8511 ships an equivalent port written against dev (commit eb15543ea) that does not depend on 03 — if 03 ever merges upstream, prefer that one instead. Keep after 03.

fixes.title: Stop stranding background tasks when activity reads fail
fixes.why: session-activity.ts detached an SDK method (const sessionGet = client.session.get), so this._client was undefined and every read degraded to unavailable — which suppresses stale interruption — with no completion watchdog. Two review tasks stranded for six hours.
fixes.orderNote: Independent of 01-04. Safe anywhere in the order.

fixes.title: Bound provider-error continuation retries
fixes.why: A retryable provider error (HTTP 503) let the todo-continuation enforcer re-dispatch indefinitely, burning tokens against a provider that was down. Adds isRetryableProviderError() and bounds consecutive retries.
fixes.orderNote: Adds the handler/session-state/types surface that 07 and 08 build on. Keep first.

fixes.title: Pause continuation after repeated provider failures
fixes.why: Continuation kept firing after the provider had already failed repeatedly. Idle events now consult the provider-failure boundary and honour the recovery window instead of resuming immediately.
fixes.orderNote: Depends on 06's session-state fields. Keep after 06.

fixes.title: Preserve the provider failure streak across non-idle events
fixes.why: Non-idle events reset consecutiveProviderFailures to 0, so any unrelated event defeated the retry bound added by 06 and the failure loop continued.

fixes.title: Align the continuation progress type import
fixes.why: Type-only fix: ContinuationProgressUpdate and SessionStateStore were imported from the wrong modules, so the 07/08 surface failed typecheck.
fixes.orderNote: Import alignment for the 07/08 surface. Keep after 08. Deliberately has NO markers: it only touches a test file and a type-only import, both erased before bundling, so no string from it can ever appear in dist/index.js and a marker would make the step-4 bundle check fail forever. Applied by cherry-pick; not bundle-verifiable by design.

fixes.title: Extend the first-prompt watchdog so a slow first token can arrive
fixes.why: The runtime-fallback watchdog fired before a slow provider produced its first token, swapping out a healthy-but-slow model mid-request. Raises the default to 180s.
fixes.orderNote: Independent of 06-09. Safe anywhere after 05. No upstream PR filed yet.

fixes.title: Track explicit cancellation state on a task
fixes.why: Adds cancellationRequested to the background task type so the manager can tell a real user cancel apart from an idle-event race.
fixes.orderNote: Types-only change that 12 consumes. Keep before 12. No upstream PR filed yet.

fixes.title: Preserve background-agent lifecycle events during cancellation
fixes.why: A cancellation racing an idle event dropped the task's terminal lifecycle events, so downstream consumers never observed the task finishing. Defers, replays, or discards them deterministically instead.
fixes.orderNote: Depends on 11's cancellationRequested field. Keep last. No upstream PR filed yet.

externalFixes.title: squeez wrap must not leave a tool call pending on timeout
externalFixes.why: squeez prints its timeout notice but never returns control for wsl.exe commands (one call held a tool for 21,893s). The plugin now injects a supervisor for WSL commands only: bounded wait, taskkill /F /T /PID, exit 124.
externalFixes.note: Not part of the OMO repo; unaffected by an OMO update.
